newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 3c to 548/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 3c to 548/kg.

text.p: The Australian eastern wool market indicator rose three cents to 548 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Melbourne on Wednesday, Wool International (WI) said.
In a firmer merino fleece market, 19/24 microns were 1.0 percent dearer, while 20/21m was slightly dearer and 22m was 0.5 percent dearer. The 21/22m were generally unchanged.
In merino skirtings 19/20m were 1.0 percent cheaper and 21/22m were generally unchanged.
In crossbreds, 27/28/29m were 0.5 percent dearer, 30m was unchanged and 31m slightly dearer.
In cardings, lambs and locks were slightly cheaper. Crutchings were generally unchanged.
WI said most interest came from Japan and Western Europe with support from most other sectors.
Of 22,235 bales offered in Sydney and Melbourne, 12.9 percent was passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle, with about 40,000 bales to be offered.
